detail.longDescription: I often use Codex/Claude for long-running tasks such as coding or video editing and hate it when it gets stuck while I’m away from my computer. I want a way to check in and operate my computer without being at my computer. So I built ClawdTime. It FaceTimes me whenever it needs my input or has something to show me, and it zooms into the relevant window. I can also FaceTime it and have it run tasks on my Mac while it shares the screen. All comments welcome!
